APPROVE
The extraction moves the per-method loop and nested ternary chain (most of the original 38) into `NestControllerMethods` and `NestDecision`, and preserves behaviour: `A || B ? …` already parsed as `(A || B) ? …`, and reordering the side-effect-free `||` operands changes nothing. It should build, provided `List<Decorator>` matches what `f.DecoratorsBefore` returns; the source wasn't available here, so I couldn't confirm that.
